internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:50 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service, with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds, exceeding the 1-second threshold. Concurrently, CPU utilization was observed to be very high at 98%, indicating resource exhaustion as a contributing factor.

Diagnosis confirmed the latency and CPU issues. To mitigate, the flag controlling CPU usage limits was disabled at 12:10 UTC, which led to a rapid recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (around 0.12 seconds).

No error injection or increased error rates were detected, ruling out errors as a cause.

The incident is now resolved and the service is stable. Further monitoring will continue to ensure no recurrence.

We identified that high CPU usage contributed to the slowdown and took corrective action to restore normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
